phases.name: create_servers_collection_and_default_s1
actions: insert single doc server_id=s1, status=open, opened_at=now

phases.name: create_server_profiles_for_existing_users
actions: for each user in users: insert server_profiles{account_id=user_id, server_id=s1, level_on_server=user.level or 1, ...}

phases.name: tag_server_bound_docs_with_server_id_s1
actions: add server_id=s1 to user_heroes, teams, inventory, story_progress, gacha_history, user_affinity_state, gift_transaction_ledger, user_gift_inventory, guilds, arena_rankings, event_progress

phases.name: move_free_currencies_to_server_wallet
actions: create server_wallets_free{account_id, server_id=s1, gold, diamonds_free, event_currency}

phases.name: update_query_contracts_require_server_id
actions: update read/write code (not in this task) to filter by account_id+server_id

phases.name: dual_read_compatibility_window
actions: reads accept either {user_id} legacy or {account_id, server_id}
phases.acceptance: no 5xx, no data loss in canary

phases.name: post_migration_validators_and_smoke
phases.acceptance: all PASS + second_server_opening_allowed=true gated by explicit approval
